newsitem.title: CANADA: Finding Tyco's Elmo toy no laughing matter.
newsitem.headline: Finding Tyco's Elmo toy no laughing matter.

text.p: It is red, fuzzy and giggles when squeezed and it has Canadian toy retailers this Christmas crying out for more.
It is Tyco Toys Inc.'s "Tickle Me Elmo" doll, based on the cuddly character from the popular children's television show "Sesame Street".
"There's nothing like the Elmo doll this year. I have no idea why it's so popular, but if you want one, I'm afraid you're out of luck," said Allison Lundel of Eaton's department store in Toronto.
"It's not as big as the Cabbage Patch Kids, but it's a similar thing," said Doug Hutcheon, president of Tyco Toys Canada.
"I have parents calling me here asking where they can get one, but I just can't help them. We just don't have any left."
The Elmo doll, which sells for about C$40 ($29.40), will not be available again until mid-January.

"It's become a worldwide hit," Hutcheon said. "The U.S., Australia and Mexico are going through the same thing, the same shortage. We knew it was going to be a good item, but you can't plan for a phenomenon like this."
